name: zclass_class_try_free_node
description: zClass_Class::TryFreeNode clears a queued-transform flag, removes the node from active lists, then either frees it immediately or queues it for deferred freeing.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers null, immediate-free, deferred-free, and pending-free drain paths. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass list/free-list pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x447b60 validates null-node return 5, clearing flag bit 1, DeleteNodeFromLists, ProcessDeferredWork branch, FreeNodeToFreeList immediate path, NodeList::Insert deferred path, and zero success return.
The native smoke verifies immediate free-list return, deferred pending-free insertion, ProcessPendingFrees cleanup, and null-node error return.
